doc.title: Nicki Parrott interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 2, 2020 [interview 2 of 2]

title: Future studies of the pandemic's effects
summary: Monk compares it to studies after Katrina; Nicki agrees there will be much looking back.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Yes. Well I appreciate your time, Nicki, and you’ve given us a lot of valuable information I think. You know people are going to be writing papers and, just like they did with Katrina in New Orleans, people studied the effects of that, so I’m sure we’ll be doing that.
Yes. Oh definitely. Like shoulda, woulda, coulda — there’s going to be a lot of talk for months and years about this.
